title: D1: deploy to prod + end-to-end verification of workstreams A, B, C
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Verification sections A.3, B, C-prod (epic tk-vau).

After A2 + B1 + B2 + B3 + C1 are done and merged (CI builds image per commit, ghcr yurifrl/board-games:latest + short-sha tags):
1. helm upgrade with updated chart (cluster: talos, KUBECONFIG=~/.kube/config-dell01).
2. Verify A: _backup/ objects in the assets bucket; submit a manual board-games-sync workflow → Succeeded.
3. Verify B: push a vault commit → sync auto-fires; cronworkflow list empty.
4. Verify C: promote via bg-admin → hard-reload bg.syscd.live → new cover immediately (no 24h wait).
Optional disruptive drill (only on request): scale obsidian to 0, wipe /data/catalog.json on the PVC, run sync, assert restored + site serves games, scale back.
acceptance_criteria: bg.syscd.live serves the catalog after a fresh-PVC + dead-Obsidian restore path; vault push auto-syncs within ~a minute; promotion reflects on live immediately; no cron workflows remain; all unit suites green.
